mechanism: Torsemide-induced electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium and magnesium) increases risk of QT prolongation and arrhythmias, which tetrabenazine can also cause independently through dopamine antagonism.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly, maintain adequate potassium and magnesium levels, perform baseline and periodic ECG monitoring, and consider alternative diuretics if QT prolongation develops.
